definitions.accuracy: Individual seed losses averaged, no prediction ensemble.
definitions.cost_center: Per fit: median of three block medians; group center: arithmetic mean of individual fit medians. F0 post excluded. Within-block raw 20-pass IQR remains in rows. No independent-sample confidence interval.
definitions.memory: Maximum observed peak across the three blocks and selected seeds; minimum retained separately.
definitions.training: Observed selected runs with different stopping epochs; elapsed times are not controlled speed ratios.
definitions.shared_parameters: Fitted coefficients are stored as buffers at inference; zero registered nn.Parameters does not mean no fitted model.
